## Summary

<!-- What changed, and why? Keep this focused on the outcome. -->

## Intended behavior

<!-- For behavior changes, describe what users should observe or link the relevant acceptance criteria. Otherwise, write "Not applicable." -->

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] User-visible feature or behavior change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Other (describe in the summary)

## Verification

<!-- List the focused checks you ran and their results. For behavior changes, include the relevant test or explain why one was not practical. CI runs the full verification suite. -->

## Compatibility, data, or security impact

<!-- Note migrations, compatibility concerns, security implications, or rollout risks. If none, write "None known." -->

## Related issue or discussion

<!-- Link the related issue. For substantial features or high-risk changes, link the issue or discussion where the approach was agreed before implementation. For a small change with no issue, write "Not applicable." -->

## Supporting documentation (optional)

<!-- Link or attach OpenSpec or other supporting documents if they help explain the change. These are welcome, not required; maintainers keep the canonical project specifications in sync. -->

## Review focus

<!-- What should reviewers look at first? Mention important trade-offs or anything intentionally out of scope. -->

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for behavior changes, or explained why tests were not practical.
- [ ] I documented relevant compatibility, data, security, or rollout risks above.
- [ ] I have not included secrets or unrelated changes.

<!-- You may use any tools or workflow you prefer. Gentle AI, ODD, OpenSpec, and other agent tooling are not required. A maintainer approval and a passing `verify` check are required before merge. -->
